eyebrow: The Boring Bogey Blueprint · White tees
title: South Nine
sub: Manderley on the Green · South 9 · White · Par 35 · 2,755 yds
thesis: Every yardage and hazard here is off your White-tee GPS, so this is the real card. One pattern dominates: LEFT is where the trouble lives. Creek the whole way down #2, plowed field down #4, road and OB on #5, a pond left of #9 from 200 to 260, and greenside bunkers left on #1, #3, #6 and #8. Your miss is a push RIGHT, which on this nine is the safe side eight holes out of nine. Stop fighting it: aim up the left edge of safe and let it drift right. Two exceptions with trouble both ways, #3 and #7, are centre-only. And #5 is S.I. 1: a tree chute that doglegs left at 205, where the play is 4H, not driver. Advance to a full club, take your bogey, bank 44.

tempo.label: One cue, every club
tempo.note: And smooth means FULL and COMMITTED, not light, not steery. Every green you hit in reg at Marchwood came from a committed smooth swing; the short-rights came from decelerating.

bag.html: Hybrids carry 10-15 MORE than the iron #

steps.v: Driver, smooth · RIGHT-CENTER. Bunker LEFT at 150, tree cluster center/right around 185, the right side threads both
leaves 133 → a full 6i
6i to FRONT-CENTER · bunkers left-front AND right
If the trees at 185 look tight off the tee, 5H (165) leaves 153 and a 6H in, same bogey, no gamble.
Driver, smooth · RIGHT-CENTER. Creek runs the WHOLE left side; fairway bunker RIGHT is 220, you land short of it
4H (178) to SHORT-CENTER, short of this green is a fine place to be
Chip on, 2 putts, bogey 5
Creek left is the ball-loser and the green is bunkered both sides. Three-shot par 4; firing the 4H at the flag is where "more" becomes a slice.
6i (135), the creek crosses at ~100 and wraps BOTH sides. Carry is 105ish
NOT the 7i. 120 barely clears and the push-right lands in the water wrapping the right.
LONG-center is the only dry miss. Bunker sits left of the green.
You made par on the Canadian's 125-yd water carry. Same shot, 7 yards shorter. Commit.
Driver, smooth · CENTER. Open plowed FIELD down the entire LEFT; trees + bunker RIGHT 150-200
leaves 144 → 5i, smooth (6i is 9 short here)
5i to FRONT-CENTER · bunkers left-front and right
No bail-out either side. If driver feels loose, 4H does the same job with half the spread.
4H (180), NOT driver. Dense trees both sides, road/OB far LEFT, and it doglegs LEFT at ~205. 180 sits just short of the corner
leaves 155 → 6H. Position first, distance second.
6H to the FAT CENTER · small green, bunkered both sides
S.I. 1 and the narrowest hole out here. Driver has nowhere to miss and can run through the corner. Bogey is a win, take the 5 and walk.
5H (165) · CENTER-RIGHT. Dead on the number; the bunker is front-LEFT
Long or right-center is fine. Short-left is the sand. No water anywhere on this hole.
164, not the 159 on the printed card. 6H (155) leaves you short-left, straight into the only bunker.
Driver, smooth · CENTER. Ditch + treeline LEFT the whole way; bunkers RIGHT at 145 and 165, 185 clears both
5H (165) → 350. Creek cuts in from the RIGHT at 250-280, so this one CARRIES it, center, no fade
leaves 109 → full 8i to center
Pond sits right of the green and a bunker guards left-front. Three centered swings, take the 6.
6H (155), smooth · CENTER, let it run on. Bunker front-LEFT, more sand LONG-RIGHT beyond the green
Center or short-center. Never long-right.
Easiest index on the nine. Don't reach for a 5i to cover the last 6 yards, that's the slice.
Driver, smooth · CENTER-RIGHT. Pond sits LEFT from 200 to 260; bunker RIGHT ~200; tree clumps center 100-150
4H (180) → 365. Stay CENTER-RIGHT again, a pull here is still in the pond
leaves 129 → 6i to center. 6i over 7i: no push-right into the right greenside bunker
494 today, 13 longer than the card. Widest hole out here and S.I. 15, but it's the last hole, and this is exactly where "a little more" cost you a ball at Marchwood.

keysTitle: Five things to run the South
keys: LEFT is the trouble side on 8 of 9 holes. Creek (#2), plowed field (#4), road/OB (#5), pond (#9), greenside sand (#1, #3, #6, #8). Your natural miss is a push RIGHT, on this nine that's a gift. Aim up the left edge of safe and let it drift right.

#3 and #7 are the exceptions, centre only, no shape. #3 has the creek across the front wrapping both sides; #7 has ditch LEFT and creek cutting in from the RIGHT at 250. Full club, dead center, commit.
Two holes where driver is the wrong club. #5 doglegs left at 205 inside a tree chute, 4H. #1 has trees center at 185, if it looks tight, 5H and a 6H in gets the same bogey.
Smooth is not light. Full and committed. "More" gave you a slice right AND less distance three times in one round. If smooth won't get there, club up, never swing harder.
Putts: die it at the hole. Lines are good, speed is the miss. Short putts lean right → aim the LEFT EDGE.
footer: White tees · Par 35 · target 44 · "last:" from your Aug 7 practice round (48). LEFT is trouble on 8 of 9.
